name: Tumblr Bot
headline: Tumblr Bot: Automate Follows, Likes & Reposts
short_description: Tumblr Bot by Somiibo automatically follows users and likes, reposts, and comments on Tumblr posts. Ideal for marketers and creators looking to grow their Tumblr presence through automated engagement.
author: somiibo

sections.overview:
Tumblr Bot is free automation software by Somiibo that handles repetitive Tumblr engagement tasks on your behalf. It automatically follows users, likes posts, reposts content, and leaves comments, helping you grow your Tumblr audience without manual effort. The bot is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux, making it accessible across major desktop platforms. It is well-suited for social media marketers, bloggers, and content creators who want to maintain an active Tumblr presence and increase their reach through consistent, automated interactions.
Automatically follow targeted Tumblr users to grow your follower base
Like posts in your niche to increase visibility and engagement
Repost relevant content to keep your Tumblr feed active
Auto-comment on posts to drive engagement and community interaction
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/somiibo/tumblr-bot`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a Tumblr bot for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. Automatically follow users interested in [TOPIC], and like, repost, and comment on posts related to [TOPIC]. Engage with users by asking questions and sharing insights. Use a friendly and professional tone. Follow Tumblr's community guidelines and avoid spammy behavior.
```
